Players Committee card image of [[Relatively Unprotected]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. While you occupy two battlegrounds (or opponent's site), you lose no more than 1 Force to Carbon-Freezing or That Thing's Operational. (Immune to Alter.) OR Deploy on a Star Destroyer or vehicle; its immunity to attrition is -4 and it may not 'react'.”
